exposure: uterine artery chemoembolization (UACE) combined with hysteroscopy and curettage
uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with hysteroscopy and curettage
outcome: beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) reduction on postoperative day 1
cohort: The study included 84 patients with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent either UACE or UAE combined with hysteroscopy and curettage.
finding: UACE was as effective and safe as UAE in the treatment of CSP, with UACE leading to a shorter time to resumption of menses compared with UAE, and both methods having similar re-pregnancy outcomes.
